name: outreach-pack
description: Claude Guide for Outreach: 32 Claude skills for opening conversations with people you do not yet know, following one outreach run in eight stages: decide who to reach with an ideal client profile, a target account list and a warm path check; research the company with a sourced fact list and a research brief; research the person with a contact shortlist and an identity check; find the reason to write with a trigger event scan; write it yourself from talking points and a cold email outline; check and send in small runs with a message checklist and a run of ten plan; go from reply to meeting with reply triage, first call prep and a call recap; then review what worked with an outreach log and a review of your own counts. For founders, independents and sellers. Claude researches and prepares; you choose the people, write every word and press send.
